text: Today's market, in thirty seconds. Tech is leading. The Nasdaq and S and P 500 are pushing to fresh highs, powered by semiconductor strength and AI earnings. But the rally is narrow. The Dow has lagged. Investors are watching for cracks under the surface. The other big story is oil. Higher energy keeps inflation sticky, which makes the Fed's path harder to read. The bottom line: bullish on mega-cap tech, cautious on the rest of the market, and focused on oil, earnings, and rate expectations. That's your daily pulse. See you tomorrow.
